_comment: Canonical SoM inherited perk database. Edit here; tools/generate_perk_registry.py validates it and writes the C registry, CSV and docs. Never renumber an id once released.

disciplines.title: Swordsman
disciplines.note: also holds the Valkyrie ideas (ally guarding, landing shockwaves, lance bash)

disciplines.title: Mage
disciplines.note: the Archmage of the design brief

disciplines.title: Warlock
disciplines.note: also holds the Starlancer ideas (star marks, orbits, event horizon)

disciplines.title: Archer
disciplines.note: also holds the Gunslinger ideas (ricochet, quickdraw, gun kata)

disciplines.title: Hunter
disciplines.note: the Hunter of the design brief

disciplines.title: Universal
disciplines.note: no discipline: unlocked by the hero's own level

capacity._comment: capacity = base + hero level / per_hero_levels, at most max (level 1: 6, 24: 12, 48: 18, 96: 30)

perks.name: Wide Whirlwind
perks.description: Whirlwind reaches 4 pixels farther.

perks.name: Cleave
perks.description: Axe Cleave also hits a second monster within 16 pixels of the first for half the damage.

perks.name: Battle Maiden
perks.description: 15% more damage while an ally within 32 pixels is below half HP.

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.description: Blocking gives the nearest ally a shield of 10% of the blocked blow.

perks.name: Divine Descent
perks.description: Landing from a Bash or a jump attack sends a 24-pixel shockwave that staggers.

perks.name: Sky Piercer
perks.description: Bash (R2+A) through two monsters hits both for 20% more (SoM has no airborne monsters).

perks.name: Heavenly Guard
perks.description: While you guard, allies behind you within 32 pixels take 25% less damage.

perks.name: Rescue
perks.description: Hitting a monster that is attacking an ally interrupts it.

perks.name: Meteor Strike
perks.description: Charge level 3 or higher hits shake the ground: a quarter of the hit to the monsters within 32 pixels.

perks.name: Valhalla
perks.description: Killing a boss, or a monster with twice your max HP, gives 20% more damage for 20 seconds.

perks.name: Divine Intervention
perks.description: An ally falling below 15% HP gets a shield of 20% of your max HP (once a minute).

perks.name: Last Stand
perks.description: Below a quarter of your HP you take half damage and deal 30% more; above half HP you deal 15% less.

perks.name: Iron Body
perks.description: Your hurt stagger ends a quarter sooner.

perks.name: Inner Peace
perks.description: Out of a fight (no monster within 128 pixels for 5 seconds) you heal 1% of max HP each second.

perks.name: Empty Hand
perks.description: Glove hits deal 15% more damage, in any discipline.

perks.name: Flowing Fist
perks.description: Each glove hit within a second of the last refills 10% of your weapon gauge.

perks.name: Iron Palm
perks.description: Charged glove hits stagger the monster.

perks.name: Pressure Point
perks.description: Critical glove hits lower the monster's defence by 10% for 5 seconds, up to 3 times.

perks.name: Falling Mountain
perks.description: 30% more damage on a staggered monster.

perks.name: Qi Burst
perks.description: Every 5th hit releases a shockwave: a quarter of that hit to the other monsters within 32 pixels.

perks.name: Rising Dragon
perks.description: Combo finishers stagger every monster within 32 pixels (SoM monsters cannot be launched).

perks.name: Reversal
perks.description: A perfect block strikes back at once with a palm for half your last hit.

perks.name: Ukemi Spring
perks.description: A successful ukemi gives back an AP pip and makes your next hit 25% stronger.

perks.name: Thunder Step
perks.description: Intercepts send a 24-pixel shockwave that staggers the monsters around the one you stopped.

perks.name: Hundred Hands of Time
perks.description: Each Intercept during bullet time adds half a second to it, up to 3 seconds in all.

perks.name: Diamond Body
perks.description: While your class energy is above half, hits take 40% less HP, paid from the energy instead.

perks.name: Shadow Step
perks.description: Your dodge rolls travel 4 frames further.

perks.name: Featherweight
perks.description: Moogle, Snowman and Balloon wear off 30% sooner on you.

perks.name: Kawarimi Reflex
perks.description: Kawarimi (the substitution log) is ready again 30% sooner.

perks.name: Shadow Pursuit
perks.description: Attacking within half a second after a dodge steps you 16 pixels toward the target, where the ground allows.

perks.name: Shinobi Reflex
perks.description: The ukemi window is 6 frames longer.

perks.name: Silent Death
perks.description: 40% more damage on a monster that faces away from you and is not attacking.

perks.name: Afterimage
perks.description: A perfect dodge leaves an afterimage that bursts half a second later for half your last hit on monsters within 24 pixels.

perks.name: Poison Fang
perks.description: Critical hits poison the monster.

perks.name: Vanishing Act
perks.description: A kill hides you: monsters hold their attacks on you for 1.5 seconds.

perks.name: Smoke Bomb
perks.description: Being hit below half HP throws smoke: monsters within 48 pixels hold their attacks for a second.

perks.name: Kunai Mark
perks.description: Thrown hits mark the monster; your next melee hit on it uses the mark for 30% more damage.

perks.name: Shadow Clone
perks.description: Every 4th hit of a combo is repeated by a shadow for 40% of its damage. Shadow hits never make shadows.

perks.name: Ninpo Doubling
perks.description: Kage Bunshin clone strikes set off your on-hit perks at half strength (one step deep only).

perks.name: Way of the Shadow
perks.description: Perfect dodges cost no AP and make your next hit critical, but you can no longer guard.

perks.name: Spellblade
perks.description: Casting a spell makes your next melee hit within 3 seconds 30% stronger.

perks.name: Wide Focus
perks.description: 10% more spell damage while no monster is within 32 pixels of you.

perks.name: Frostbite
perks.description: Water spells slow the monster to half speed for 1.5 seconds.

perks.name: Mana Siphon
perks.description: Critical hits restore 1 MP.

perks.name: Static Charge
perks.description: Each melee hit stores a charge (up to 5); your next spell spends them for 6% more damage each.

perks.name: Elemental Blade
perks.description: After an elemental spell, your weapon carries that element for 8 seconds (15% more against a weakness).

perks.name: Elemental Convergence
perks.description: Casting a different element than your last spell adds 15% damage, up to 3 times.

perks.name: Combustion
perks.description: A fire spell kill sets the monsters within 32 pixels alight for 20% of the killing blow.

perks.name: Arcane Echo
perks.description: Every 4th spell echoes half a second later on the same monster for 40%.

perks.name: Arcane Barrier
perks.description: A quarter of the damage you take is paid with MP instead (1 MP per 4 HP).

perks.name: Overcharge
perks.description: Spell damage beyond the monster's remaining HP explodes onto the monsters within 32 pixels.

perks.name: Mana Shell
perks.description: All damage drains MP first (1 MP per 3 HP); at 0 MP you take 25% more damage.

perks.name: Blessing
perks.description: Your heals also give their target a shield of 5% of its max HP for 5 seconds.

perks.name: Sacred Flame
perks.description: 30% more damage against undead.

perks.name: Retribution
perks.description: Taking damage makes your next hit within 3 seconds 25% stronger.

perks.name: Judgement
perks.description: 20% more damage on a monster that hurt an ally in the last 3 seconds.

perks.name: Sanctuary
perks.description: Allies within 48 pixels of you get a tenth of each hit back.

perks.name: Divine Echo
perks.description: Every 3rd heal repeats a second later for 30%.

perks.name: Mercy
perks.description: Heals on someone below a quarter of their HP are 50% stronger.

perks.name: Purification
perks.description: A perfect block clears your bad statuses.

perks.name: Martyr
perks.description: A quarter of the damage allies within 48 pixels take is moved to you.

perks.name: Providence
perks.description: Every 10th kill heals the whole party 5%.

perks.name: Resurrection
perks.description: A fallen ally rises with a quarter of their HP 5 seconds later (once every 3 minutes).

perks.name: Saint's Vow
perks.description: Overhealing becomes a shield of up to 20% max HP; your own hits deal 25% less.

perks.name: Stardust
perks.description: Every 6th hit throws a spark at the nearest other monster for 10%.

perks.name: Cosmic Reach
perks.description: Hex Chain reaches 25% farther.

perks.name: Stellar Pierce
perks.description: Your dark spells ignore 15% of magic defence.

perks.name: Constellation
perks.description: Three hits on one monster mark it with a star.

perks.name: Eclipse
perks.description: Critical hits confuse the monster for 3 seconds.

perks.name: Blood Price
perks.description: With too little MP, your spells cost 8% of your max HP instead.

perks.name: Supernova
perks.description: Killing a star-marked monster bursts for 30% of the killing blow on the monsters within 40 pixels.

perks.name: Astral Pursuit
perks.description: Your drawn bolts turn toward star-marked monsters.

perks.name: Comet Trail
perks.description: Dodging through a monster's spot hurts it for 20% of your last hit.

perks.name: Orbital Guard
perks.description: Two stars circle you at 24 pixels; each hits a monster it touches once a second for 10%.

perks.name: Event Horizon
perks.description: Finishers pull the monsters within 48 pixels toward the point of impact, where the ground allows.

perks.name: Black Star
perks.description: Critical hits no longer deal extra damage: they detonate for half the hit on the monsters within 32 pixels.

perks.name: Familiar Bond
perks.description: Your familiar has 30% more HP.

perks.name: Eternal Companion
perks.description: Your familiar stays bound 50% longer.

perks.name: Shared Instinct
perks.description: Your familiar attacks the monster you are locked on to.

perks.name: Shared Vitality
perks.description: Heals on your familiar also heal you for a quarter of the amount.

perks.name: Pack Tactics
perks.description: 15% more damage while an ally or familiar is within 48 pixels of your target.

perks.name: Spirit Resonance
perks.description: Each familiar hit makes your next hit 15% stronger, up to 3 times.

perks.name: Tag Team
perks.description: Hitting your familiar's target within a second of its hit: 20% more damage.

perks.name: Echo Summon
perks.description: Every 4th familiar strike repeats for half its damage.

perks.name: Guardian Spirit
perks.description: A fifth of the damage you take goes to your familiar instead.

perks.name: Spirit Fusion
perks.description: When your familiar falls, you deal 25% more damage for 8 seconds.

perks.name: Wild Calling
perks.description: After each minute of fighting with no familiar, a Rabite joins you for 15 seconds.

perks.name: Soul Bond
perks.description: You and your familiar split all damage evenly, and it never leaves while you live.

perks.name: Battle Rhythm
perks.description: Each hit within 0.75 seconds of the last adds 3% damage, up to 5 times.

perks.name: Graceful Step
perks.description: Your evades are ready 25% sooner.

perks.name: Inspiring Presence
perks.description: Allies within 64 pixels refill their weapon gauge 10% faster.

perks.name: Waltz
perks.description: Dodging past a monster within 16 pixels throws it off balance: your next hit on it deals 25% more.

perks.name: Crescendo
perks.description: 2% more damage per hit in your combo, up to 20%.

perks.name: Perfect Tempo
perks.description: A swing pressed within 6 frames of the gauge filling deals 15% more damage.

perks.name: Synchrony
perks.description: An ally's hit within a second keeps your combo alive.

perks.name: Encore
perks.description: Every 3rd combo finisher strikes again for half its damage.

perks.name: Grand Finale
perks.description: A combo of 10 hits or more ends with a burst: 30% of the finisher on the monsters within 32 pixels.

perks.name: Pirouette
perks.description: A perfect dodge spins: a quarter of your last hit to the monsters within 24 pixels.

perks.name: Duet
perks.description: When two players hit the same monster within half a second, both hits deal 25% more.

perks.name: Endless Dance
perks.description: Your combo never ends while you hit or dodge every 1.5 seconds; a hit taken resets it and stuns you half a second.

perks.name: Seamless Transition
perks.description: Switching weapons keeps your combo count.

perks.name: Versatility
perks.description: A weapon switch starts the new weapon's gauge a quarter full.

perks.name: Arsenal Mastery
perks.description: The first hit within 2 seconds of a weapon switch deals 25% more damage.

perks.name: Momentum
perks.description: Each hit in a chain adds a frame to your dodge, up to 4, for 3 seconds.

perks.name: Quick Hands
perks.description: Weapon switches are ready again 30% sooner.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: A hit with a different weapon type than your last hit staggers the monster.

perks.name: Adaptive Reach
perks.description: If the target is out of reach after a switch, your next attack steps up to 12 pixels in, where the ground allows.

perks.name: Execution Flow
perks.description: A kill keeps your combo alive one second longer.

perks.name: Unbroken Rhythm
perks.description: One whiff per combo does not end it.

perks.name: Pierce then Cleave
perks.description: A spear hit followed within a second by an axe hit: the axe hit deals 20% more and staggers.

perks.name: Arsenal Overflow
perks.description: Hitting with 3 different weapons in one combo restores 15 class energy.

perks.name: Dancing Steel
perks.description: Switching weapons mid-combo releases a radial cut: 30% of your last hit to every monster within 32 pixels.

perks.name: Thousand Weapons
perks.description: A combo finisher gives every weapon type used in that combo 10% more damage for 10 seconds.

perks.name: Endless Arsenal
perks.description: Every weapon switch refills the gauge and adds 15% damage, but two hits in a row with the same weapon deal 40% less.

perks.name: Backstab
perks.description: 35% more damage from behind a monster.

perks.name: Treasure Hunter
perks.description: Monsters drop their rare item more often.

perks.name: Opportunist
perks.description: 25% more damage on a monster in the half second after its own attack.

perks.name: Pickpocket
perks.description: Every 8th hit on a monster lifts a little GP (twice your level).

perks.name: Evasive Instinct
perks.description: A close dodge makes your next hit within 2 seconds 30% more likely to be critical.

perks.name: Ambush
perks.description: The first hit of each fight deals 50% more and staggers.

perks.name: Dirty Fighting
perks.description: Critical hits confuse the monster.

perks.name: Hemorrhage
perks.description: Three hits on one monster within 2 seconds make it bleed: three ticks of 5% of your hit over 3 seconds.

perks.name: Exploit Weakness
perks.description: 20% more damage on poisoned, confused, asleep or frozen monsters.

perks.name: Escape Artist
perks.description: Your own bad statuses wear off 40% sooner.

perks.name: Feint
perks.description: Shadowstepping behind a monster makes its next attack strike its nearest fellow monster instead.

perks.name: Knife in the Dark
perks.description: Hits from behind are always critical; hits from the front deal 25% less.

perks.name: Iaijutsu Focus
perks.description: The first hit after 3 seconds without landing one deals 20% more damage.

perks.name: Death's Edge
perks.description: Hits on a monster below a quarter of its HP deal 25% more damage.

perks.name: Zanshin
perks.description: A kill refills your weapon gauge at once, so the next swing is a full one.

perks.name: Duelist
perks.description: 15% more damage on a monster with no other monster within 64 pixels.

perks.name: Unwavering Spirit
perks.description: While you charge an attack, a quarter of each hit you take is given back.

perks.name: Bushido
perks.description: A perfect block makes your next successful hit within 3 seconds deal 35% more damage.

perks.name: Mushin
perks.description: A perfect dodge makes your hits critical 25% more often for 4 seconds.

perks.name: Severance
perks.description: Charged hits add 15% of their damage again as a cut that ignores defence.

perks.name: Tsubame Gaeshi
perks.description: Every counter (guard counter, parry, Intercept) is followed by a returning slash for half its damage.

perks.name: Sword Saint
perks.description: Each sword hit in a row without being hurt adds 4% sword damage, up to 5 times. Getting hurt clears it.

perks.name: Nagashi
perks.description: Blocks within a second of each other each raise your next counter's damage by 20%, up to 3 times.

perks.name: Kirisute
perks.description: A kill with a charged hit sends a crescent cut to the nearest other monster for 60% of the killing blow.

perks.name: Okuri Kaze
perks.description: Your hits during bullet time are held back and all land together when it ends, 10% stronger.

perks.name: Ichi no Tachi
perks.description: Your first hit on each monster deals double damage; every later hit on it deals 30% less.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.description: Switching to a bow, boomerang or javelin fills its gauge at once.

perks.name: Deadeye
perks.description: 20% more damage on a monster more than 64 pixels away.

perks.name: Last Bullet
perks.description: Every 6th ranged hit deals 60% more damage.

perks.name: Gun Kata
perks.description: Ranged hits on a monster within 24 pixels stagger it.

perks.name: Gun and Blade
perks.description: Alternating melee and ranged hits adds 10% damage each time, up to 3 times.

perks.name: Explosive Rounds
perks.description: Critical ranged hits explode: 30% to the other monsters within 24 pixels.

perks.name: Steady Breath
perks.description: A perfect dodge starts one second of bullet time (the Monk's).

perks.name: Trick Shot
perks.description: Volley arrows turn toward your locked target.

perks.name: Skeet
perks.description: 40% more damage on flying monsters (bats, birds, bees).

perks.name: Ricochet
perks.description: A ranged hit bounces once to another monster within 64 pixels for half the damage. Bounces never bounce.

perks.name: Piercing Shot
perks.description: A ranged hit also strikes the monster behind the target in a line (48 pixels) for 60%.

perks.name: Dead Man's Hand
perks.description: Ranged hits deal 50% more, melee hits 50% less, and you cannot guard.

perks.name: Hunter's Mark
perks.description: Three hits mark a monster for 10 seconds; the whole party deals 10% more to it.

perks.name: Tracking
perks.description: Lock-on reaches 50% farther.

perks.name: Predator
perks.description: 20% more damage on beasts (rabites, wolves, tigers, lizards).

perks.name: Eagle Eye
perks.description: Holy Water and the thrown cross fly 20% farther.

perks.name: Hamstring
perks.description: Whip hits on a marked monster slow it to half speed for a second.

perks.name: Patient Hunter
perks.description: Standing still for 1.5 seconds makes your next hit 40% stronger.

perks.name: Survivalist
perks.description: Healing items heal 25% more.

perks.name: Camouflage
perks.description: After 2 seconds standing still, monsters hold their attacks on you until you move.

perks.name: Stake Through the Heart
perks.description: An undead monster below 20% of its HP dies to your next hit.

perks.name: Trophy Collector
perks.description: Bosses and large monsters drop 50% more GP.

perks.name: Apex Predator
perks.description: Marked monsters alone (no other within 64 pixels) take 35% more; killing one restores 10 class energy.

perks.name: Night Hunter
perks.description: 40% more damage against undead and bosses, 25% less against everything else.

perks.name: Soul Harvest
perks.description: Each kill heals you 3% of your max HP.

perks.name: Bone Armour
perks.description: Each kill gives a shield of 5% of your max HP for 10 seconds, up to 3 times.

perks.name: Grave Chill
perks.description: Critical hits slow the monster to half speed for 2 seconds.

perks.name: Death Echo
perks.description: A kill releases spectral energy: 15% of the killing blow to the monsters within 32 pixels. Echo kills do not echo.

perks.name: Soul Reservoir
perks.description: Kills store a soul (up to 5); your next spell spends them for 10% more damage each.

perks.name: Spectral Blade
perks.description: Every 5th hit adds a ghostly slash for 30%.

perks.name: Death Pact
perks.description: Below 30% HP, your familiar deals 50% more damage.

perks.name: Corpse Bloom
perks.description: Killing a poisoned monster poisons the monsters within 32 pixels.

perks.name: Grave Marks
perks.description: Your hits mark a monster; marked monsters take 15% more from familiars.

perks.name: Reanimation
perks.description: A monster killed by your dark spell rises as an undead familiar for 20 seconds (one at a time).

perks.name: Undying
perks.description: Once every 5 minutes, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 HP.

perks.name: Lich Pact
perks.description: Your max HP counts as 30% lower; your familiar deals double damage and heals you 10% of its hits.

perks.name: Field Engineer
perks.description: Items you use work 20% better.

perks.name: Reinforced Armour
perks.description: 8% of each physical hit you take is given back.

perks.name: Salvager
perks.description: Kills give 10% more GP.

perks.name: Overclock
perks.description: Planting a bomb or mine refills your weapon gauge.

perks.name: Improvised Explosives
perks.description: Critical hits drop a small bomb that bursts a second later: a quarter of the hit within 24 pixels.

perks.name: Mine Field
perks.description: Your mines last twice as long and you may place one more.

perks.name: Magnetic Retrieval
perks.description: Dropped chests within 48 pixels drift toward you.

perks.name: Volatile Mixture
perks.description: Hits on a poisoned monster burst for 15% on the monsters within 16 pixels.

perks.name: Emergency Repair
perks.description: Once per fight, dropping below 20% HP uses a Candy from your bag.

perks.name: Chain Detonation
perks.description: Your bombs and mines set each other off within 32 pixels.

perks.name: Automated Defence
perks.description: Every 20 seconds of fighting, a small turret appears beside you and shoots for 5 seconds.

perks.name: Mad Bomber
perks.description: Your explosions deal 60% more but also hit you for 10% of their damage.

perks.name: Telekinetic Reach
perks.description: Pulling a dropped chest (L2+X) works from 50% farther.

perks.name: Levitation
perks.description: Knockback you take is halved.

perks.name: Lingering Whisper
perks.description: Whisper marks last twice as long and a monster can carry 4.

perks.name: Psychic Attraction
perks.description: Every 4th hit pulls the monster 8 pixels toward you, where the ground allows.

perks.name: Repulsion
perks.description: Being hit pushes the monsters within 32 pixels 12 pixels away.

perks.name: Psychic Echo
perks.description: A critical hit repeats as a psychic strike half a second later for 40%.

perks.name: Mind Break
perks.description: Each Whisper mark lowers the monster's magic defence by 10%.

perks.name: Precognition
perks.description: In any discipline, a monster starting its attack shows the Intercept '!', and a dodge inside that window counts as perfect.

perks.name: Psychic Shield
perks.description: Every 10 seconds, the next hit you take is absorbed up to 15% of your max HP.

perks.name: Kinetic Conversion
perks.description: 5% more damage for every 8 pixels you moved in the last second, up to 25%.

perks.name: Gravity Well
perks.description: Combo finishers pull every monster within 48 pixels 12 pixels toward the finisher's target, where the ground allows.

perks.name: Puppet Master
perks.description: Misdirection lasts 3 swings instead of one, but your own hits deal 30% less.

perks.name: Chrono Counter
perks.description: A perfect block starts one second of bullet time (the Monk's).

perks.name: Temporal Distortion
perks.description: Landing 3 hits within a second slows every monster within 64 pixels to half speed for 2 seconds. You keep your speed.

perks.name: Psychic Acceleration
perks.description: While any time effect of yours is running, your weapon gauge refills twice as fast.

perks.name: Temporal Pursuit
perks.description: After hitting a slowed monster, your next dodge toward it covers double distance, where the ground allows.

perks.name: Chronostasis
perks.description: An Intercept or a perfect dodge freezes that attacker for one second (a third of a second on bosses).

perks.name: Temporal Echo
perks.description: Every 3rd combo finisher repeats at the spot where it landed one second later, for half its damage.

perks.name: Borrowed Time
perks.description: Damage you take is put back at once and taken again over 3 seconds instead (never more than you lost).

perks.name: Temporal Reversal
perks.description: Double-tap L2 to return to where you stood 2 seconds ago. Fails if the way back is blocked; never undoes items or kills.

perks.name: Time Fracture
perks.description: Combo finishers freeze every monster within 32 pixels for half a second.

perks.name: Temporal Field
perks.description: Combo finishers leave a 48-pixel field for 3 seconds; monsters inside move at half speed.

perks.name: Frozen Arsenal
perks.description: Monster projectiles that enter your time field stop for a second, then fly back toward their shooter.

perks.name: Paradox
perks.description: Hits on a frozen monster are stored and all land when it thaws, 20% stronger.

perks.name: Time Prison
perks.description: Intrusion: Hold keeps its monster frozen 2 seconds instead of 1.5, and nothing can push it out.

perks.name: Time Collapse
perks.description: Your stored damage no longer lands by itself; L2+R2 releases all of it at once, 50% stronger (20-second cooldown).

perks.name: Chrono Sovereignty
perks.description: Every combo milestone adds a quarter second to each time effect you own (up to 2 seconds each); your time effects cost 25% more energy.

perks.name: Full Force
perks.description: At full HP your hits deal 10% more damage.

perks.name: Second Wind
perks.description: Once per fight, dropping below 20% HP heals you 15%.

perks.name: Clean Fight
perks.description: Each fight won without being hurt gives 5% more damage in the next fight, up to 3 times.

perks.name: Target Hopper
perks.description: Switching lock targets keeps your combo count.

perks.name: Ukemi Master
perks.description: A successful ukemi makes your next hit 20% stronger.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.description: Healing above your max HP becomes a shield of up to 10% of max HP.

builds.name: Phantom Samurai
builds.idea: A supernatural swordsman who dodges into counters and leaves shadows behind.

builds.name: Gravity Monk
builds.idea: Pulls monsters together, staggers the crowd and bursts it with Qi.

builds.name: Death's Orchestra
builds.idea: An undead band whose hits keep the dancer's combo alive.

builds.name: Celestial Gunslinger
builds.idea: Arrows mark monsters with stars and the kills cascade.

builds.name: Immortal Weaponmaster
builds.idea: Thrives on long fights: kills heal and shield, one death is refused.

builds.name: Phantom Shinobi
builds.idea: Moves through slowed time and leaves afterimages.

builds.name: Astral Fist
builds.idea: Freezes a monster and pours a glove combo into it that lands all at once.

builds.name: Void Swordsman
builds.idea: Six cuts on a frozen foe, the sword is sheathed, time resumes and they all land.

builds.name: Psi Gunner
builds.idea: Arrows and enemy shots hang in the air, then fly.

builds.name: Psychic Arsenal
builds.idea: Weapon switches inside slowed time.

builds.name: Soul Weaver
builds.idea: Delays death and lets spirits take the blows.

builds.name: Gravity Sovereign
builds.idea: Bends gravity and time around every finisher.

builds.name: Reality Weaver
builds.idea: Elemental spells cast into time fields.

builds.name: Chrono Sovereign
builds.idea: A martial artist bending space, gravity and time; the keystone extends every time effect.

builds.name: Shadow Duelist
